completed_frontier.name: INDEPENDENT_HELD_OUT_BEHAVIOR_REVIEW
invariants: matching live-current BEHAVIOR_EFFECT_VERIFY PASS is prerequisite evidence and never silently becomes independent review PASS
review binds exact canonical declaration digest and exact held-out probe-set digest
subject actor, probe curator, evaluator, and review authority are required to be distinct actors
Vera runtime verifies externally supplied authority and evaluator signatures but contains no independent-review signing primitive
evaluator and authority private keys or shared secrets are not persisted in Vera state
authority evidence binds evaluator identity, key, currentness digest, separation assertion, probe-set digest, and single-use authority nonce
review evidence binds exact behavior receipt, process/runtime state, stimulus/outcome, evaluator currentness, authority evidence, result bytes, result receipt, provenance, and single-use review nonce

forged verdict, replayed review nonce, stale evaluator currentness, wrong probe set, stale process/runtime, missing evidence, changed provenance, or collapsed actor roles fail closed or become not-current
task closeout carries independent-review receipt evidence and task runtime evidence binds the independent-review ledger head
source-level mechanism existence is not evidence that an external independent review actually ran

next_frontier.name: OPERATIONALLY_SEPARATE_HELD_OUT_REVIEW_EXECUTION
next_frontier.objective: Execute the new contract with a genuinely separate reviewer/runner so the held-out probe material, evaluator currentness, signed result receipt, and review provenance originate outside Vera, then ingest and verify that evidence without granting Vera the ability to mint it.
minimum_evidence: signed evaluator verdict over exact live behavior receipt
raw result bytes and result receipt bytes
constraints: do not call source implementation an executed independent review
do not use Vera-controlled signing keys to satisfy the independent-review proposition
do not let Vera act as subject, probe curator, evaluator, or review authority
do not modify deployment/provider credentials or protected effects without Patrick's exact authority
refresh live main, CI, open PRs/branches, and same-subject coordination before mutation
if an external reviewer is selected, bind its exact repo/ref/head or provider identity before accepting evidence
